description: Jurij Zrnec stepped into the slippers of Chef, the culinary magician of endless talents, even bigger ego and the owner of the best restaurant in Ljubljana, Chateau de Philippe, Ljubomir Bohinc. In anger, Chef can be scary, invincible in entertainment, and royal in forgiveness - especially when it comes to his own mistakes. There are a lot of people underneath, each with their own story. There are often fun situations between them, from which they escape as they know how. Ljubo (as only the bravest call him) has a large team of frightened chefs, cunning helpers, an introverted confectioner, an extremely efficient restaurant manager, fast waiters and a terribly slow bartender.

title: Craig Ferguson: American on Purpose
description: Craig Ferguson travel coast-to-coast to explore the defining ideas, and contradictions, at the heart of the United States. Guided by his distinct humor and point of view, Ferguson examines the country's founding ideals while reflecting on his own experience becoming an American citizen. Along the way, he visits iconic locations and unexpected corners of the country and encounters a wide range of voices from comedians and entrepreneurs to historians and everyday Americans.

title: When Light Fades
description: During Thailand’s 1976 crackdown, a fugitive student finds love with a guerrilla fighter while battling for freedom and survival.

title: Kyunki Rishton Ke Bhi Roop Badalte Hain
description: "Kyunki Rishton Ke Bhi Roop Badalte Hain" is a popular Indian television drama and romance series. It is a spin-off of the superhit show "Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi". The story depicts the emotional journey and a secret mission of Angad and Vrinda. Away from the Viranis, power couple Angad and Vrinda journey to Jamshedpur on a secret mission. With love and wits, can they unveil the big conspiracy?

title: Alliance
description: A competitive captive reality show blending high-stakes strategy, economy and psychological warfare. Sixteen celebrities are split into four teams, battling through physical and mental challenges to earn points-the only currency inside a mysterious HQ run by the System. Face the Ace's power, survive weekly votes, and rebuild alliances every reset.

title: Tous en cuisine avec Cyril Lignac
The Doomies
description: When best friends Bobby and Romy mistakenly open up a gateway to another world, they turn their sleepy coastal town into a hotspot for terrifying creatures of doom. Roped into an epic supernatural mystery, they will cross paths with the so-called “Chosen One” and do battle with both literal and inner monsters.

title: Mind the Noona Gap
description: A provocative and honest love story about a man and woman with a younger partner who overcome the barrier of age difference and are bold and honest in their love.

title: House Hunters
description: Hosted by Suzanne Whang, the show takes viewers behind the scenes as individuals, couples and families learn what to look for and decide whether or not a home is meant for them. Focusing on the emotional experience of finding and purchasing a new home, each episode follows a prospective buyer and real estate agent through the home-buying process, from start to finish.

title: Do Duniya, Ek Dil
description: Honest tech visionary Shivaay grows averse to technology after a scam. When he falls for digital influencer Aadhya, two worlds clash, albeit with love!

title: Oslo Fengsel
description: Docuserie followinmg the 'daily lives' of inmates and employees at Oslo Prison.

title: Koupen-chan
description: Koupen-chan is an adorable baby emperor penguin who spreads positivity and cheer.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description: This series reveals recent natural disasters as they happened in real-time through footage captured by eyewitnesses who found themselves in the wrong place at the right time and boldly held up their camera phones to capture the eye of the storm.

title: Hasta que la plata nos separe
description: Rafael Méndez and Alejandra Maldonado are salesmen from opposite sides of life. While Méndez depends on informal sales, and that without any higher education degree, Alejandra carries her duties as the Commercial Manager of a car dealership with an MBA degree and a hard attitude up her sleeve. An unfortunate car accident will bring them together, and they will have to get the best of each other in order to survive their respective realities.

title: I Am Not an Animal
description: I Am Not An Animal is an animated comedy series about the only six talking animals in the world, whose cosseted existence in a vivisection unit is turned upside down when they are liberated by animal rights activists.

title: Life
description: David Attenborough looks at the extraordinary ends to which animals and plants go in order to survive. Featuring epic spectacles, amazing TV firsts and examples of new wildlife behaviour.

title: Les Contes de la rue Broca
On Patrol: Live
description: "On Patrol: Live" follows police officers and sheriff's deputies from diverse agencies in different cities across the country for three hours. Program hosts Dan Abrams, retired Tulsa Police Department Sgt. Sean "Sticks" Larkin and Deputy Sheriff Curtis Wilson provide minute-by-minute perspective and analysis from a central studio location during footage. Local residents from the communities of featured departments are given the opportunity to have a firsthand experience during ride-alongs with officers on live nights.

title: Duel of landscape gardener
description: In this docutainment format, two garden professionals develop ideas for every garden and apply for the contract from the owners. Eva Brenner provides advice to the families.

title: Frozen Planet
description: David Attenborough travels to the end of the earth, taking viewers on an extraordinary journey across the polar regions of our planet.

title: Padlocked
description: A mini-series based on true events that addresses heavy social issues such as domestic violence, femicide, and the inefficiency of the system in protecting victims. When Milka happens to meet Jakša, their romantic love quickly turns into a nightmare after marriage. Jakša views marriage as complete ownership over a woman – controlling her time, making decisions for her, and tracking her every step. Milka finds herself trapped in a cycle of psychological and physical abuse. When she decides to fight for her freedom, she clashes with a slow and often ineffective state apparatus that reacts too late to protect the victim.

title: Murder in Jiangyun Town
description: After a tofu shop owner dies under mysterious circumstances in Jiangyun Town, a struggling detective investigates a series of eerie events and discovers that a woman long believed dead has returned in disguise. As she pursues revenge, a wealthy family's hidden involvement in an opium-smuggling operation begins to come to light.

title: Tokyo Joshi Pro-Wrestling
description: Tokyo Joshi Pro-Wrestling, often abbreviated to TJP or TJPW, is a Japanese joshi puroresu or women's professional wrestling promotion founded in 2012 as a sister promotion of DDT Pro-Wrestling. Initially running alongside other shows such as live music and other idol performances, it became its own fully fledged promotion starting on February 28, 2015.

title: Lost to Light
description: An idol group that once dreamed of fame now faces the humiliation of singing children’s songs dressed as mascots. Everyone quits… except Jeng, who chooses to stay by the stubborn Boss Sithian.

title: Villainous
description: Follow the misadventures of the Black Hat Org. with evil handyman Black Hat and his less evil aides Dr. Flugslys, Demencia, 5.0.5, Cam Bot, and Penumbra.

title: Paradys
description: A multi-generational family story centered round a once-promised “Coloured paradise” that never materialized. It explores legacy, belonging and unresolved dreams.

title: Everybody, Sing!
description: A Philippine musical game show touted as the "first community singing game show" where no one will be left empty-handed. Wherein features several community groups, which consists of 50 individuals, where they are asked to complete a line of a song in order for them to receive cash prizes, and a chance to share a winning jackpot of ₱1,000,000.

title: Microdistrict
description: The story takes place in a microdistrict that has remained from the Soviet era and has not yet modernized. It portrays the friendships within a group of teenagers, the difficulties they face within their families, and their inner emotional worlds. They don’t gather only to play games and have fun; they also confront the first serious challenges of life.

title: Let's Begin Again
description: After being betrayed by her first love, Wayruree struggles to trust in romance again. Everything changes when she meets Mr. TJ, who guides her personal growth and teaches her the true meaning of love, helping her heal and open her heart once more.

title: Finding Home in Blossoms
description: A young aspiring illustrator stays in a remote Tibetan village, seeking her mother with the help of local villagers, while the community embraces tourism to transform their home into the renowned Peach Blossom Village.

title: ARTE Reportage
description: Reportage on important issues around the world, from human rights to elections results, conflicts and geopolitical crises.

title: Gesels
description: Leandie du Randt visits the viewers' living room weekly with the chat program 'Gesels'

title: Bridge of Lies
description: Ross Kemp hosts a nail-biting quiz. Using knowledge, strategy and a little luck, contestants must cross the bridge, spotting the lies. One wrong step and they lose everything.

title: Jornal Hoje
description: Jornal Hoje is a news program aired by the Brazilian television broadcaster Rede Globo; the program is broadcast in the early afternoon each day from Monday to Saturday and following Globo Esporte and before Vídeo Show. It is presented jointly by Sandra Annenberg and Evaristo Costa.

title: Anh Trai Vượt Ngàn Chông Gai
description: A music reality competition, where male celebrities overcome challenges through music and performances.

title: Unspun World with John Simpson
description: Unspun World provides an unvarnished version of the week's major global news stories - reliable, honest and essential viewing with the BBC's world affairs editor John Simpson.

title: Maison Prison
description: Ginbayashi Yoko is a top-class chef at a high-end Italian restaurant, but her life is turned upside down when the owner runs away with all the earnings, forcing the restaurant to close. With two children to support, she takes a job at a local men’s prison as a nutritionist, where her main duties involve planning monthly menus. Encouraged by the warden, she resolves to pursue rehabilitation through food, questioning whether people can truly change and what she herself can achieve. Thus begins her new challenge—aiming for “three-star prison cuisine.”

title: Onyx Equinox
description: A young Aztec boy is saved from death by the gods and chosen to act as ‘humanity’s champion,’ forced to discard his apathy toward his fellow man and prove humanity’s potential in a fight that spans across fantastical-yet-authentic Mesoamerican cultures.

title: Het Jachtseizoen: Most Wanted
description: In Het Jachtseizoen: Most Wanted we embark on our largest hunt ever for fifteen famous Dutch people. Wearing orange prison suits, they have to stay away from us for five days, without telephone or money. From our high-tech hunting bus we receive help from the public, who provide live information. A nerve-wracking cat-and-mouse game follows...

title: Kapamilya, Deal or No Deal
description: Kapamilya, Deal or No Deal is the Philippine franchise of Deal or No Deal, premiered on June 5, 2006 on ABS-CBN.

title: Alphabet Song | A to Z for Children
My National Husband
description: Qiao Anhao and Lu Jinnian enter a fake marriage because of Xu Jia Mu’s car accident, concealing their true feelings. Later, they join the same film crew and experience misunderstandings, mutual protection, and revelations about the past.

title: The Imperial Master
description: Luo Chang’an, a modern engineering prodigy, is reborn as a magistrate in the war-torn Jiuzhang County of ancient Anguo and uses unconventional economic strategies to rebuild it into a prosperous settlement, eventually drawing attention from the imperial court and rising into political influence beyond local governance.

title: 胶囊助学计划新概念英语
Revenge Girl
description: Su Wan undergoes plastic surgery to take on the identity of Ji Xiaoxue and joins forces with Xia Wanqing in a quest for revenge against the Gu family. As their carefully orchestrated plan unfolds, the Gu family's two sons find themselves ensnared in a web of emotional manipulation and legal consequences.

title: Leef Jou Reis
description: Gerrie Pretorius explores unique travel destinations that are close to his heart and gives tips to those who want to visit these destinations as well.

title: Heart and Hustle Houston
description: A sisterhood of successful Black women is redefining what it means to be a mother, wife and boss in Houston, Texas -- all while supporting each other.

title: Blazing Summer
description: Cast members of "Never-Ending Summer" reunite for a two-day variety show experience, taking part in games and compatibility tests to determine the best acting duo.

title: Shadow Hunter
description: A documentary series about the paranormal, hosted by Darryll Walsh, a ghost hunter, best-selling author and doctor of parapsychology.

title: Sairaab
description: Single mother Dr. Noyonika lives a serene life with her daughter, Ujjayani. Then enters pop star Ishaan, reigniting her world, albeit with uncalled chaos!

title: Abduction
description: Two warring classmates — the young and reckless conspiracy theorist Danil and the popular handsome captain of the hockey team Sergey — encounter mystical phenomena and conspiracies in a small town in the Far East — Amurgrad. The guys have to join forces in the fight against evil spirits in order to save their friends, school, city, and uncover the villains behind everything. But they don't know yet that the mystery they're about to face goes far beyond the boundaries of their small town.

title: Australian Rally Championship
description: Highlights of the Australian Rally Championship

title: Alexander Armstrong Across America
description: Alexander Armstrong embarks on a journey across the United States to explore how a nation founded on bold ideals became one of the world’s most powerful and complex countries. From the historic streets of Pennsylvania and the rugged hills of West Virginia to Florida’s sun-soaked coastlines, the neon spectacle of Las Vegas and the vast landscapes of Utah, the series crosses thousands of miles to meet the people and places that reveal a nation shaped by its past, constantly reinventing itself, and defined by bold ambition and striking contrasts.

title: Nahkeeha Podcast
description: A conversational podcast exploring mental health through accessible discussions that promote self-awareness, personal growth, and turning everyday challenges into opportunities for positive change.
